# Gadre Empire

> Gadre Empire is a MahaRERA-registered (P52800055538) project of shops and 1 & 2 BHK flats by M/s. Savkar & Company, in the centre of Sakharpa market, Sangameshwar taluka, Ratnagiri district, Maharashtra, India.

## Key facts
- Developer: M/s. Savkar & Company
- Address: Town Bazaar, Kondgaon (Sakharpa), Tal. Sangameshwar, Dist. Ratnagiri 415801
- Coordinates: 16.9841685, 73.6919731
- Offer: shops, 1 BHK flats, 2 BHK flats
- Location: 500 m from the Ratnagiri–Kolhapur highway; school, hospital and bus stand nearby
- Features: Vastu-compliant homes, 24x7 water, CCTV, lift with power backup, covered parking for flats, large four-wheeler parking, children's play area and garden, shopping passage, large windows for natural light
- Contact: +91 88307 86262, +91 70707 99711, WhatsApp https://wa.me/918830786262
- Prices and sizes: shared on call or at the office
